mostWorthwhile.text: Connecting the lungs to circulation was most worthwhile because the result showed how oxygen reaches distant tissues and how blood returns.

leastWorthwhile.text: The required order for connecting the airways was initially unclear: the capillary mesh seemed to fit the lined sacs directly.

surprise.text: I was surprised that the airways had to be connected before the capillary mesh, though the feedback made the next step clear.

arbitrary.text: The airway-first requirement felt somewhat arbitrary from the visible pieces, even though the automatic combination kept play moving.

continue.text: I would choose to continue: building the breathing mechanism and then connecting it to circulation made me curious about how the remaining body systems fit together.
